note_on_tiny_ds_diffs_in_first_pass: The validation script initial run reported Delta_s differences of ~1e-17 (machine epsilon) on 2/6 events. Root-caused: hit coordinates were independently confirmed bit-identical (0.0 diff) between baseline and optimized on ALL 6 events; since Delta_s is a deterministic function of hit coordinates, this proves the tiny diff was an artifact of the validation scripts OWN redundant Delta_s recomputation path for the baseline side (via a CSV-round-tripped copy of the hit coordinates, subject to text-serialization precision loss), not a real difference between the two integrators. Corrected analysis (comparing hit coordinates directly, bypassing the redundant recompute) confirms exact bit-identical agreement throughout.
